svg.title: Figure 6. Rich-to-rich routing
svg.desc: Figure 6. Two dot charts of the ratio of real rich-to-rich routes through the connective to the rewired mean. By share of partners counted as rich: 1% 1.17, 2% 0.93, 5% 1.10, 10% 1.10, 20% 1.02, 30% 1.03, 50% 1.01; significant at 5%, 10%, 30% only. By edge threshold: 0.5% 1.002, 1% 1.103, 2% 1.391, 5% 1.605; the excess vanishes at 0.5% and grows as weak connections are dropped.
